morphology.formula: ∅ + clark → clark；作为姓名时规范写作Clark
morphology.pattern_note: 依输入保留根词标记，不将其解释为马来语词根。所列英式读音不发元音后的r；常见美式读音为/klɑrk/。没有依据生成马来语派生词，故词族留空。

senses.zh_definition: 克拉克：英语姓氏，也可用作名字；在马来语文本中属于保留原拼写的专有名词。
senses.en_definition: Clark: an English-language surname, also used as a given name.
senses.ms_definition: Clark ialah nama keluarga dalam bahasa Inggeris yang juga digunakan sebagai nama diri.
senses.nuances: 此处noun具体指专有名词kata nama khas。历史来源与表示教士、书记等身份的词有关，但现代姓名Clark不能直接译成“书记”或kerani，也不能自动视为clerk的拼写错误。姓名、读音及来源见[Behind the Name：Clark](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/clark)。以下是姓名组合示例，不是经统计验证的高频词汇搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Clark belongs to a family of occupational surnames connected with clerks and clerics. In medieval Europe, religious training and literacy often went together, so words for religious personnel also developed associations with writing and record-keeping. The inherited surname preserves that history without describing the occupation or beliefs of its present-day bearer. [Source: Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/clark).
